content:
#1 The Stacks Project people have what seems to be a spin-off product, Gerby, that is designed to handle very large dynamic mathematical documents with a good tagging system (like the Stacks Project itself). I do wonder if there is anything that either the nLab, or Urs personally, could do with this.

Also, apparently Lurie is adopting Gerby to run a new website, Kerodon, and got a professionally designed logo for it. I do wonder if he is moving into this space rather than writing multi-thousand page pdfs as is his current mode, with fragile reference numbers.
subject: Gerby
